notes: Trigger words and strengths are publisher hints, not measured quality guarantees.
The baseline receives the same prompt, including the trigger, seed and sampler settings.
HF EllaPriest45/MinimaxH3_Actions is a mirror; its embedded text is attributed to the original author where possible.
REF2VA guide/edit LoRAs must not be benchmarked as plain FL2VA I2V adapters.

realism.photo: 1536x1024 PNG, adult, front or 30-45 degree yaw, face 35-55% of frame height, visible pores and flyaway hair, soft 45-degree key plus weak fill, no beauty filter, no HDR halos, no pre-sharpening
realism.video: Optional 124-frame 24fps guide for REF2VA only; plain realism/detail I2V uses the photo
realism.acceptance: Keep an unretouched but well-focused source; detail LoRA cannot recover information absent from the source

detail.photo: Same as realism; include one naturally sharp and one mildly soft/compressed copy, never an artificially pixelated face for the main test
detail.video: V04: 1024x576, 124 frames, 24fps, single locked shot, mild real compression/softness, same aspect ratio at output; REF2VA restore and sharpness require guide/Add Guide wiring
detail.acceptance: Compare same seed and prompt; reject HF temporal growth above 10% even if static Laplacian rises

motion.photo: 1024x1536 full-body or medium-wide, all articulating limbs visible, no motion blur, feet and contact surfaces visible
motion.video: 1024x576, 107 or 124 frames at 24fps (4.46/5.17s), one continuous take, fixed camera unless camera LoRA is tested; motion must begin and end inside the clip
motion.audio: Not required except speech/audio-specific adapters; use silent 48kHz stereo for the common runner
motion.acceptance: Score temporal continuity and parked-frame runs, not just per-frame detail

face.photo: Minimum 1024px long side, neutral expression, open eyes, unobstructed jaw/forehead, face at least 256px and 35% of image height, front view for identity; 3/4 view as a second test
face.video: V03: 1024x576 or 720x1280, 124 frames, 24fps, one adult speaker, fixed camera, intelligible dry speech; 48kHz mono dialogue plus silent stereo carrier as required by runner
face.acceptance: Face MAE is a fixed-ROI pixel proxy, not identity recognition; inspect expression and lip sync separately

anatomy.photo: Consensual adult synthetic/reference asset, 1024x1536, target anatomy and interacting hand/object unobstructed and in the starting pose, front/rear/below angle stated explicitly, even soft light, no cropped contact point
anatomy.video: Optional 2:3 124-frame 24fps guide, fixed medium shot, action and contact point visible throughout; use 5-10s for insertion/withdrawal or repeated motion
anatomy.acceptance: Keep face and anatomy tests separate; do not infer skin improvement from an anatomy adapter

camera.photo: 1536x1024 medium-wide with clear foreground/background separation, subject entirely in frame, no existing extreme lens blur
camera.video: V05: 1024x576, 124 frames, 24fps, static plate with parallax objects; POV tests need visible body parts appropriate to the requested viewpoint
camera.acceptance: Use fixed seed and prompt; evaluate unwanted zoom/shake in the baseline as well as intended camera motion

nsfw.photo: Adult-only, consensual dataset, 1024x1536, exact starting pose, anatomy and hands visible, no occlusion at contact point, simple background, soft light
nsfw.video: 2:3, 124-241 frames at 24fps (5-10s), one static medium shot; complete movement cycles inside the clip; audio only for adapters explicitly trained with audio
nsfw.acceptance: Run separately from skin/identity benchmarks; count frozen adjacent-frame pairs and inspect anatomy/contact drift

utility.photo: P05: at least output resolution, clean single-subject identity reference; edited first frame must have the same geometry as the guide
utility.video: V06: 1024x576 or source-matched aspect, 73 or 124 frames at 24fps, one shot, no cuts; Add Guide/frame-aligned source for edit LoRAs; no turbo for Character Swap Pro
utility.acceptance: These are not drop-in I2V realism boosters; use their required REF2VA guide/reference graph
